verdict.rationale: Zulip's official API documents a 'Send a message' endpoint, and its bot framework is described as reacting to messages in Zulip, so an agent can plausibly both read and post channel messages through first-party interfaces. The evidence never mentions scoped tokens, bot-specific API keys, or any permission limits on credentials, so that part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented scoped/least-privilege API tokens, explicit read/fetch-messages API documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usage.
